messages:
Alex Chen: quick design review — attaching screenshots in thread. focused on the compact action bar inside the alert preview modal. two things I want feedback on: (1) icon-only actions vs labeled buttons (space is tight) — should we keep persistent tooltips? (2) suppression toggle copy + aria labeling. cc @Marie O'Connor for visual polish :eyes:
Marie O'Connor: love conserving space with icons, but tooltips are a must for discoverability. also the icon background contrast looks low on the dark theme — feels muddy. maybe a subtle outline on focus? :thinking:
Jonathan K: +1 on tooltips. for a11y we should include aria-labels and clear expanded/collapsed states on overflow menus. quick snippet: ```<button aria-label="Mute alert" title="Mute">...</button>``` and use `aria-expanded` on the overflow toggle.
Priya Singh: copy nit — product prefers the verb 'Suppress' instead of 'Mute' or 'Snooze' because it better communicates temporary suppression. suggest default label: 'Suppress for 1 hour'. API note: make sure backend accepts a 'suppress' action with duration.
Sam M: from eng POV: suppression action should be idempotent and return the resulting state immediately. UX should show a toast with an undo option. don't block the UI waiting for analytics. :thumbsup:
DesignBot: automated contrast check: icon bg #5a6b7c fails AA small text. recommended accessible color: #425660.
Alex Chen: also thinking about channel/recipient preview — today the preview shows compact pills which are hard to parse quickly. idea: inline 'Preview' affordance that opens a small pane with channel avatar + last 3 recipients. lightweight, not a full modal.
Marie O'Connor: hover-only previews are problematic for keyboard and touch. make the preview reachable via focus and add a visible 'Preview' button that opens the pane. keep hover as enhancement only.
Jonathan K: accessibility bits for the preview: ensure it gets role="dialog" when opened via keyboard, trap focus inside, and add `aria-describedby` that points to the suppression explanation copy. also announce open/close to screen readers.
Priya Singh: draft microcopy for suppression tooltip: 'Suppress notifications for 1 hour. You can change this duration in Settings.' shorter alternative: 'Suppress for 1 hour — change in Settings.' which is clearer in tight layouts?
Sam M: telemetry: emit `alert_ui.suppress` with a `duration` property and `user_action=undo` when undone. infra to make suppression call idempotent so retries are harmless.
Alex Chen: action items: Marie — update visual spec + accessible color tokens; Jonathan — add aria attrs + example in code review; Priya — finalize microcopy and variants for short/long layouts; Sam — add telemetry event and ensure backend idempotency. I'll prototype the keyboard-first preview flow tomorrow and post screenshots. Thanks all! :rocket:
